name: Test Item (₹1 Demo)
desc: A ₹1 test product to verify the UPI payment flow end-to-end.

name: Kestrel K7 Full-Frame Mirrorless Body
desc: A 33MP full-frame body with fast autofocus that tracks eyes on people, animals and birds. Built for weddings, wildlife and everything between.

name: Kestrel K3 APS-C Mirrorless Camera
desc: A light 26MP camera that fits in a jacket pocket and still shoots 11 frames a second. A good first step into interchangeable lenses.

name: Vantage V1 Compact Vlog Camera
desc: A one-inch sensor, a flip-out screen and a built-in ND filter. Made for creators who shoot, edit and upload the same day.

name: Orbis 24-70mm f/2.8 Standard Zoom
desc: The everyday workhorse zoom. Sharp across the frame at f/2.8, with weather sealing and a quiet focus motor for video.

name: Orbis 50mm f/1.8 Prime
desc: Small, light and quick to focus. The classic portrait lens with soft background blur at an easy price.

name: Orbis 70-200mm f/4 Telephoto Zoom
desc: Reach for sports, stage and wildlife without the weight of an f/2.8. Optical stabilisation gives sharp shots at slow shutter speeds.

name: Orbis 16mm f/1.4 Wide Prime
desc: A fast wide lens for night skies, interiors and street work. Minimal distortion and good coma control at the corners.

name: Lumora 200W LED Monolight
desc: Daylight-balanced studio light with a Bowens mount, so every common modifier fits. Quiet fan and app control.

name: Lumora 90cm Octa Softbox
desc: Soft, wrapping light for portraits and products. Folds like an umbrella and sets up in under a minute.

name: Lumora RGB Tube Light 60cm
desc: A handheld tube with full colour control and 40 built-in effects. Works for interviews, music videos and accent lighting.

name: Ferro Carbon Fibre Tripod CF-4
desc: A four-section carbon tripod that folds to 44 cm and carries 12 kg. Stable in wind, light in a backpack.

name: Ferro Fluid Video Head
desc: Smooth pans and tilts with adjustable drag and a counterbalance. Fits any tripod with a 3/8 inch screw.

name: Ferro Pocket Gimbal Stabiliser
desc: Three-axis stabiliser for compact cameras and phones. Gives smooth walking shots without a rig.

name: Haven 25L Camera Backpack
desc: Holds a body, three lenses, a 15-inch laptop and a tripod. Side access, rain cover and a back panel that opens away from the street.

name: Haven Sling Bag 8L
desc: Swing it round to grab the camera without taking it off. Fits one body with two lenses and a few small items.

name: Vantage 128GB V60 SD Card
desc: Fast enough for 4K video and long bursts. Waterproof, shock-proof and covered by a lifetime warranty.

name: Vantage Dual Battery Charger
desc: Charges two Kestrel batteries at once from USB-C. Comes with a car adapter for long shoots.

name: Vantage ND Filter Set 77mm
desc: Three neutral density filters (3, 6 and 10 stops) for long exposures and wide apertures in daylight.
